instruction: Export this image as a JPEG file named 'Triangle.jpg' on the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened GIMP with yellow triangle image (800x800), tried to select and center the triangle using Align tool and Move tool over 30 turns, but never successfully repositioned the triangle.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus, select tools (Crop, Align, Move), change tool options (Relative to: Image), interact with Layer menu, anchor floating selections
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to properly select the triangle as a movable element. It anchored the floating selection to the background layer, then tried Align tool which aligns layers not pixel regions. The triangle remained in its original upper-left position.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a basic File > Export As operation requiring the model to navigate the export dialog, change filename and format to JPEG - all within demonstrated menu navigation capabilities.
metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting the currently open XCF image as JPEG via File > Export As. Evaluator runs the 'file' command on the expected output path and checks the output contains 'JPEG', confirming the file exists and is valid JPEG format.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly runs 'file /home/user/Desktop/Triangle.jpg' to check both file existence and format at the expected path
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies output contains 'JPEG' (confirming JPEG format) and excludes 'cannot open'/'No such file' (confirming file exists)
All instruction requirements are covered: file name ('Triangle.jpg'), location (Desktop), and format (JPEG)
Parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', the rules dict is passed directly to check_include_exclude which accesses include/exclude keys properly
No postconfig needed since verification reads the filesystem, not UI state
